description: This file contains utility functions for benchmarking GPU performance and profiling with PyTorch, including functions to dump chrome traces, parse trace events, compute GPU utilization, and benchmark GPU operations such as matrix multiplications and convolutions.

methods.name: synchronize()
methods.description: Placeholder function to synchronize device operations, typically related to GPU synchronization.

methods.name: dump_chrome_trace( f, input, trace_filename, optimize_ctx, activities, num_runs=1, devices=None, kwargs_for_f=None, kwargs_for_profiler=None, )
methods.description: Runs a function multiple times under an optimization context, profiles its execution, and exports a Chrome trace for performance analysis.

methods.name: get_chrome_trace_events(filename)
methods.description: Reads a Chrome trace JSON file and extracts its 'traceEvents' list.

methods.name: is_gpu_compute_event(event)
methods.description: Checks if a trace event corresponds to a GPU compute event based on the 'pid' and 'ph' fields.

methods.name: get_sorted_gpu_events(events)
methods.description: Filters and sorts GPU compute events based on their timestamp.

methods.name: get_duration(sorted_gpu_events)
methods.description: Calculates total duration of a sequence of sorted GPU events, considering overlapping events.

methods.name: get_sorted_gpu_mm_conv_events(events)
methods.description: Filters GPU events to include only matrix multiplication and convolution related events and sorts them.

methods.name: compute_utilization(filename: str, total_length: float)
methods.description: Processes Chrome trace data to compute GPU utilization and time spent on matrix multiplication and convolutions.

methods.name: benchmark_utilization( f, input, trace_folder, optimize_ctx=None, trace_file_name="tmp_chrome_trace", num_runs=1, )
methods.description: Runs a function repeatedly to profile GPU utilization and specialized operations, producing a Chrome trace file and calculating metrics.

ctags.name: benchmark_utilization
ctags.signature: ( f, input, trace_folder, optimize_ctx=None, trace_file_name="tmp_chrome_trace", num_runs=1, )

ctags.name: dump_chrome_trace
ctags.signature: ( f, input, trace_filename, optimize_ctx, activities, num_runs=1, devices=None, kwargs_for_f=None, kwargs_for_profiler=None, )
